title: Hunts FH-006: Add transactional run and progress tables

source.ref: Frequency Hunts Build Plan (9 Nov 2026), Tier 0, Engine. Owner asked 2026-11-09 to build the program into the site.

detail: Introduce claim, progress, command key, run, audit and compensation records with unique keys and indexed scope. Done when: Parallel credit and reused idempotency key with a different payload yield only one credit and a conflict respectively. Requires: FH-005. Owner role: Database.
